newsitem.title: UK: AB Foods at record on acquistion hopes.
newsitem.headline: AB Foods at record on acquistion hopes.

text.p: Shares in Associated British Foods Plc set a record peak on Tuesday amid speculation of future acquisitions and positive press comment in the food manufacturing sector, dealers said.
Last week ABF sold its Irish supermarket operations to Tesco Plc, adding to its cash pile and fuelling talk of possible acquisitions.
The stock was up 18p at 551 by 1041 GMT, surpassing its record of 534p set Monday. Trading volume was modest at 640,167 shares.
A report in the Evening Standard newspaper on Monday highlighted the sector's high yield and defensive qualities and said the severe squeeze on profit margins of recent years had eased.
It also pointed out that AB Foods and other leading food manufacturers had the cash to expand through acquisition.
"Having sold its Irish supermarkets it is in a position to do a deal, and (Chairman Garry) Weston has a reputation as a pretty shrewd deal doer," said one dealer.
ABF shares have risen some 15.4 percent since early this month.
Elsewhere in the sector Unilever Plc was up 22p at 16.10-1/2 stg, Dalgety Plc was up 7p at 333 and United Biscuits Plc was up 2-1/2p at 231.
